adjudication.rationale: The server-side input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts) only validates `guests` as `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness constraint. In the handler, `uniqueGuests` is computed via `guests.filter(...)` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts) but the predicate only excludes emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails; it does not remove duplicates within the incoming `guests` array. Those duplicates are then passed to `attendees.createMany` (same handler), which can create duplicate attendee rows or trigger a Prisma unique constraint error if such a constraint exists—either way, it's incorrect behavior compared to the client-side uniqueness refine.
